source: That’s splendid news! I was hoping that you’d accept this opportunity!
translation: 真是个好消息！我一直希望你能接受这个机会！

source: Thank you, Mr. Clermont for seeing something in me and giving me the chance to use my talents in the best possible way I can.
translation: 谢谢您看到了我的潜力，并给我机会以最好的方式发挥自己的才能，Clermont先生。

source: Of course! I will send the details of how you have to prepare, along with the school information, dates, and curriculum as soon as possible!
translation: 当然！我会尽快把准备事项，以及学校信息、日期和课程安排发给你！

source: Yes, sir. I’ll study it very carefully.
translation: 是的，先生。我会仔细研究。

source: A-Although, if I could make a request... Can you at least let me finish my role in the expansion project before I pursue this opportunity?
translation: 不、不过，如果我能提个请求……在追求这个机会之前，您至少能让我完成扩建项目中的工作吗？

source: Why of course! We don’t need to be in such a hurry! You wouldn’t be required to move until the end of spring!
translation: 当然可以！我们不必这么着急！你要到春末才需要搬走！

source: By then, the project is scheduled to be complete! So, please enjoy your time at Camp Buddy for a few more months!
translation: 到那时，项目预计也已经完成了！所以，请再享受几个月在 Camp Buddy 的时光吧！

source: Thank you, Mr. Clermont!
translation: 谢谢您，Clermont先生！

source: Well then, I’m looking forward to seeing you out there soon, Mr. Flynn! Have a lovely day!
translation: 那么，我期待很快在外面见到你，Flynn先生！祝你今天愉快！

source: Whew… Well, that happened.
translation: 呼……好吧，事情就这么办成了。

source: You did great, Aiden! You were very professional, and everything you said came from the heart.
translation: 你做得很棒，Aiden！你表现得非常专业，而且说的每句话都发自内心。

source: You didn’t need my help talking to Mr. Clermont after all!
translation: 看来和Clermont先生交谈时，你根本不需要我的帮助嘛！

source: Yeah… Usually talking about serious stuff like that over the phone gives me a little bit of anxiety.
translation: 是啊……平时在电话里谈这种严肃的事，总会让我有点焦虑。

source: Especially when it’s about something I tried reaching for in the past.
translation: 尤其是谈到我过去曾努力争取过的东西时。

source: After my dad passed, I was so determined to pursue cooking knowing it was the one thing I was really good at.
translation: 爸爸去世后，我下定决心追求烹饪，因为我知道那是我真正擅长的唯一一件事。

source: I went back to working all sorts of jobs to make money and save for a degree.
translation: 我又开始做各种工作赚钱，为学位攒钱。

source: But then, in the middle of all that, I finally heard from you – asking me to come back to Camp Buddy.
translation: 但在那一切进行到一半时，我终于收到了你的消息——你邀请我回到 Camp Buddy。

source: Well… It was only when I got the job here that I found out that you lost your dad…
translation: 嗯……直到我在这里得到这份工作，才知道你失去了父亲……

source: So as soon as I knew the camp needed help, you were the first person to come to mind...
translation: 所以我一知道营地需要帮忙，第一个想到的人就是你……

source: I’m really glad you decided to accept.
translation: 我真的很高兴你决定接受。

source: I was afraid of what would happen if I showed up empty-handed, but you never looked down on me or judged me.
translation: 我害怕自己两手空空地出现会发生什么，但你从没看不起我，也没有评判我。

source: You treated me the same way as when we first met.
translation: 你对待我的方式，和我们初次见面时一样。

source: Even still, I tried to save face by convincing everyone that I was only coming back to make enough money for college.
translation: 即便如此，我还是试图挽回面子，告诉大家我只是回来赚够大学学费。

source: Now I get to follow that dream for real and make something relevant out of myself.
translation: 现在我终于能真正追逐那个梦想，做出一番成绩。

source: I’ll be able to really contribute and truly belong at Camp Buddy one day!
translation: 总有一天，我会真正为 Camp Buddy 做出贡献，成为这里真正的一员！

source: Well, you’re already doing that, Aiden! But this time around, you'll get to help with something much bigger out there!
translation: 你已经在这么做了，Aiden！但这一次，你会在那里帮助完成更大的事业！

source: That’s why I’m really glad you made this decision, and see just how much potential you have, Aiden!
translation: 所以我真的很高兴你做出了这个决定，也看到了自己究竟有多大潜力，Aiden！

source: I was worried you’d miss out on this amazing chance.
translation: 我还担心你会错过这个绝佳的机会。

source: Thanks a lot for changing my mind, Yoshi. I won’t let you guys down!
translation: 非常感谢你改变了我的想法，Yoshi。我不会让你们失望的！

source: Ah. There you are, you two!
translation: 啊，你们两个在这里！

source: Good morning, Sir Goro! Sorry for the delay. Aiden just had to give Mr. Clermont a call.
translation: 早上好，Goro先生！抱歉让您久等了。Aiden刚才给Clermont先生打了个电话。

source: It’s fine. How did it go?
translation: 没关系。进展如何？

source: Well, I ended up accepting the offer. I think it was the right path for me after all, Gramps.
translation: 嗯，我最后还是接受了这份邀请。我想这确实是适合我的道路，Gramps。

source: As long as you’re happy, whatever your decision, it’ll always be the right choice.
translation: 只要你感到幸福，无论你做什么决定，它都会是正确的选择。

source: Hehe, thanks, Gramps.
translation: 嘿嘿，谢谢你，Gramps。

source: Either way, I’m glad to see you both finally resolving things with each other. We’ll need you two more than ever from here on out.
translation: 无论如何，我很高兴看到你们终于解决了彼此之间的问题。从现在开始，我们比以往任何时候都更需要你们两个。

source: Roger that, Gramps. You can count on us!
translation: 收到，Gramps。尽管放心交给我们吧！

source: Now let’s get on with things before this cheese-train gets out of control.
translation: 现在我们继续做正事吧，免得这趟肉麻列车失控。

source: *sigh* Aiden.
translation: *叹气* Aiden。

source: *ehem* I actually came here to fetch you two for our agenda today.
translation: *咳咳* 我其实是来叫你们两个去参加今天的议程。

source: The workers have just arrived and we’re gathering to discuss resuming our expansion project.
translation: 工人们刚刚到了，我们正要集合讨论恢复扩建项目的事。

source: Oh right… that’s today!
translation: 哦，对啊……今天就是那天！

source: Looks like we’re back to the grind again, huh?
translation: 看来我们又要开始苦干了，对吧？

source: Yes. Hopefully we’re through all the seasonal hiccups, and we have until spring to finish everything.
translation: 是的。希望我们已经熬过了季节性的问题，而且还有时间到春天完成所有工作。

source: Now that I’m not going anywhere, I’m sure we can pull it off, hahaha!
translation: 既然我不会离开了，我相信我们一定能做到，哈哈哈！

source: Heh. Said like a true scoutmaster.
translation: 呵，这话说得像个真正的童军团长。

source: Shall we go meet the workers then? We’ll have a short briefing on each department’s status.
translation: 那我们去见见工人吧？我们会简短介绍各部门的情况。

source: Of course, sir! We’re right behind you.
translation: 当然，先生！我们马上跟上您。

source: Whew! It’s so nice to see the camp crowded again!
translation: 呼！看到营地又热闹起来真好！

source: It’s lively.
translation: 真有活力。

source: Heh, wait till you see it with the campers. This place is cramped!
translation: 嘿，等营员们来了你再看看。这里会挤得水泄不通！

source: Good thing we expanded the camp… I don’t think we would’ve been able to accommodate everyone next term, if we hadn’t.
translation: 幸好我们扩建了营地……否则我觉得下个营期根本容纳不了所有人。

source: Were there only a few scouts last term?
translation: 上个营期只有几个童军吗？

source: Hmm, it was honestly our lowest turnout ever.
translation: 嗯，说实话，那是我们有史以来人数最少的一次。

source: What? How the heck did you manage to get sponsored by Clermont with hardly anyone here then?!
translation: 什么？这里明明没多少人，你们到底是怎么让Clermont赞助的？！

source: Well, let’s just say the last batch really showed off the spirit of Camp Buddy.
translation: 这么说吧，上上一批人充分展现了 Camp Buddy 的精神。

source: You mean Keitaro and his friends?
translation: 你是说Keitaro和他的朋友们？

source: That’s right!
translation: 没错！

source: They really left an impression on me even in the short time I spent with them.
translation: 即使只和他们相处了很短时间，他们也给我留下了深刻印象。

source: Makes me curious about their story.
translation: 让我开始好奇他们的故事。

source: Alright everyone, I’ve relayed our plan to the workers.
translation: 好了，各位，我已经把计划转达给工人们了。

source: Let me just summarize to each department what the upcoming tasks are.
translation: 让我来向各部门概括一下接下来的任务。

source: For the tech upgrades, Jin, you’ll be working alongside the construction department to set up the necessary groundwork for security cameras and internet connections.
translation: 关于技术升级，Jin，你要和施工部门一起，为安保摄像头和网络连接搭建必要的基础设施。

source: Yes, sir! The layout is already prepared!
translation: 是，先生！布局已经准备好了！

source: Good! Other than that, you can continue working on the camp database website and any integrations.
translation: 除此之外，你可以继续开发营地数据库网站和各种集成功能。

source: Next, for the construction, aside from the tech integrations, your task is mostly continuing the infrastructure plans already being worked on.
translation: 接下来是施工方面，除了技术集成之外，你们的主要任务就是继续完成已经在进行的基础设施规划。

source: When I spoke with the workers, they were all expecting to need to do repairs, but were quite happy to learn that we had already completed the majority of them.
translation: 我和工人们交谈时，他们都以为需要进行维修，但得知大部分维修已经完成后，他们都非常高兴。

source: I guess all our initiative paid off, then! We’ll get things back on track today, sir!
translation: 看来我们之前的主动行动都没有白费！今天我们会让一切恢复正轨，先生！

source: You can count on us.
translation: 尽管放心交给我们吧。

source: Good! Please let us know immediately if any other concerns come up!
translation: 很好！如果出现其他问题，请立即告诉我们！

source: For Aiden and Yoshinori, you’ll both continue your maintenance tasks and staff welfare duties.
translation: 至于Aiden和Yoshinori，你们两个继续负责维护工作和员工福利事务。

source: Gotcha, Gramps! You’ve got nothing to worry about!
translation: 明白了，Gramps！您什么都不用担心！

source: We’ll keep updating you as usual if there are any issues in our department, sir.
translation: 如果我们部门出现任何问题，我们会像往常一样及时向您汇报，先生。

source: Alright. In addition, Ms. Komarova will officially assist with the maintenance tasks, so please take her under your wing as well.
translation: 好。另外，Komarova女士将正式协助维护工作，所以你们也要好好带带她。

source: Hihi~ Look how the tables have turned~
translation: 嘻嘻～看看风水轮流转～

source: Don’t push it.
translation: 别得寸进尺。

source: As for Yuri and I, we’ll keep handling all the required paperwork and coordination with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 至于我和Yuri，我们会继续处理所有必要的文书工作，并与Clermont先生协调。

source: We’ll make sure everything is taken care of for the next summer term on the admin side.
translation: 行政方面，我们会确保下个夏季营期的一切准备就绪。

source: *sigh* More secretary work…
translation: *叹气* 又是秘书工作……

source: I’d switch tasks any day.
translation: 我随时都愿意换个任务。

source: That should be everything then. Is everyone clear on our goals?
translation: 这样就都安排好了。大家都清楚我们的目标了吗？

source: Excellent! That’s all for today’s meeting. Let’s get to work!
translation: 很好！今天的会议就到这里。开始工作吧！

source: Everyone proceeded to work for the rest of the winter, continuing where we left off with all the new goals set for us.
translation: 整个冬天，大家都继续工作，按照为我们设定的新目标，从之前中断的地方继续推进。

source: Thankfully, the weather didn’t act up for the rest of the season, letting Lloyd, Darius, and all the workers continuously make progress on the construction.
translation: 幸好，接下来的整个季节天气都很稳定，让Lloyd、Darius和所有工人能够持续推进施工。

source: Jin was also able to finish the website and all the necessary tech integrations for the camp!
translation: Jin 也完成了网站和营地所需的所有技术集成！

source: I don’t know how we would have been able to pull off all of these amazing changes if not for their expertise!
translation: 要不是他们的专业能力，我真不知道我们怎么能完成这些惊人的改变！

source: Meanwhile, Sir Goro kept the entire project well-managed, making sure we stayed on schedule.
translation: 与此同时，Goro先生把整个项目管理得井井有条，确保我们按计划推进。

source: Thankfully, Yuri was there to assist him so he wasn’t as stressed with all the paperwork as he used to be!
translation: 幸好有Yuri协助他处理事务，他不用像过去那样为文书工作承受那么大压力了！

source: Aiden and I kept up our regular maintenance duties, but this time around we had Emilia doing most of the other chores like cleaning and laundry.
translation: Aiden和我继续做日常维护工作，但这一次，其他诸如清洁和洗衣之类的杂务大多由Emilia负责。

source: She would complain as usual, but she did the job well and got it done on time!
translation: 她一如既往地抱怨个不停，但工作做得很好，也按时完成了！

source: All in all, it was amazing to see everyone work towards a common goal, all while enjoying our time together.
translation: 总的来说，看到大家为了共同目标一起努力，同时享受相处的时光，真是太棒了。

source: The days flew by, and we saw the fruits of our labor take shape as we came closer and closer to completion!
translation: 日子飞快地过去，我们离完成越来越近，也看到了劳动成果逐渐成形！

source: The snow started to thaw, and with spring just around the corner, we could clearly see how much progress we made!
translation: 积雪开始融化，春天也即将到来，我们清楚地看到了自己取得了多大的进展！

source: I can’t wait for the scouts to see how much this place has grown!
translation: 我等不及要让童军们看看这里发生了多大的变化！

source: This is such a wonderful day for Camp Buddy. We’ve all been working towards this moment for so long!
translation: 今天对 Camp Buddy 来说真是美好的一天。我们为这一刻努力了这么久！

source: Just a year ago, I couldn’t have dreamed that something like this was possible, and I have you all to thank for that.
translation: 就在一年前，我还不敢想象这样的事竟然可能实现，而这一切都要感谢你们大家。

source: This project has just been a reminder of how far we’ve all come as a team, and how much I owe each and every one of you.
translation: 这个项目提醒了我们作为一个团队走了多远，也让我意识到自己欠你们每一个人多少。

source: I’d also like to give a special thanks to Mr. Clermont, as without him we’d never have had this opportunity to grow.
translation: 我还要特别感谢Clermont先生；如果没有他，我们永远不会有机会发展到今天。

source: Thank you again, sir, for everything you’ve done, and for being here to celebrate with us today!
translation: 再次感谢您，先生，感谢您所做的一切，也感谢您今天来到这里与我们共同庆祝！

source: It was my pleasure, Mr. Nomoru.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，Nomoru先生。

source: Lastly, I want to dedicate this success to the scouts. They may not be here right now, but their spirit is what allowed this place to endure.
translation: 最后，我想把这份成功献给童军们。他们现在也许不在这里，但正是他们的精神让这个地方坚持了下来。

source: They are what makes this place worth fighting for.
translation: 正是他们让这里值得我们为之奋斗。

source: Now, let’s all celebrate the completion of our goals!
translation: 现在，让我们一起庆祝目标达成！

source: To Camp Buddy and to the future!
translation: 为了 Camp Buddy，也为了未来！

source: *cuts ribbon*
translation: *剪断彩带*

source: {i}Now that our project was officially complete, everyone began packing their things to leave.{/i}
translation: {i}现在项目正式完成了，大家开始收拾东西准备离开。{/i}

source: {i}It also meant that the time had come for us to say goodbye to our friends as well.{/i}
translation: {i}这也意味着，我们告别朋友的时刻到了。{/i}

source: I think that’s the last of it, right guys?
translation: 我想这就是最后一件了，对吧，大家？

source: Aww… I hate to leave… I’m gonna miss you guys so much!!!
translation: 哎呀……我真不想走……我会非常想念你们的！！！

source: It can’t be helped, Lloyd… Our job is contractual after all…
translation: 没办法，Lloyd……毕竟我们的工作是合同制的……

source: Yeah, and Mr. Clermont has already set us up with another gig!
translation: 对啊，Clermont先生已经帮我们安排了另一份工作！

source: Regardless, this was quite the experience.
translation: 不过，这次经历真是太棒了。

source: It’ll definitely be hard to top.
translation: 肯定很难再超越了。

source: I’m pretty bummed too… This is the first time I really had friends as close as you guys…
translation: 我也很郁闷……这是我第一次拥有像你们这样亲近的朋友……

source: The consequences of being an adult… We really don’t have time in our busy lives…
translation: 成为大人的代价……我们忙碌的生活实在没有时间……

source: I’ll still come visit every now and then, though! You guys will need some tech maintenance after all.
translation: 不过我还是会偶尔来看看你们！毕竟你们还需要技术维护。

source: Nooooo! Jin… my only fudanshi friend… Don’t leave me!!
translation: 不——！Jin……我唯一的腐男子朋友……别离开我！！

source: It’s okay, Yuri, we can always share online! I gave you my Dicksword ID.
translation: 没关系，Yuri，我们随时可以在线分享！我把我的 Dicksword ID 给你了。

source: We could always hang out outside of Camp Buddy too, right?! A little get together?!
translation: 我们也可以在 Camp Buddy 之外一起玩，对吧？！来个小聚会？！

source: *sigh* I’d love to, but the culinary school I’m headed to is two flights away.
translation: *叹气* 我很想去，但我要去的烹饪学校要坐两趟飞机才能到。

source: I’m actually scheduled for my entrance exam later today too.
translation: 而且我今天晚些时候还安排了入学考试。

source: Wahh, congrats again on your exciting career, Aiden!
translation: 哇，恭喜你又一次开启激动人心的职业生涯，Aiden！

source: I’m sure you’ll ace it.
translation: 我相信你一定能考得很好。

source: Y-You can do it, Aiden!
translation: 你、你一定可以的，Aiden！

source: Thanks, guys!
translation: 谢谢大家！

source: Huhuhu!! First Lloyd, Darius, and Jin are leaving, and now Aiden too! I can’t take all of this! I’m gonna cry!
translation: 呜呜呜！！Lloyd、Darius和 Jin 要走了，现在连Aiden也要走！我受不了了！我要哭了！

source: Calm down, Yuri… It’s not like they’re dying.
translation: 冷静点，Yuri……又不是他们要死了。

source: I’m sure everyone here will do their best to stay in touch.
translation: 我相信这里的每个人都会尽力保持联系。

source: Hmph! Emilia is lucky she gets to stay!
translation: 哼！Emilia真幸运，能留下来！

source: Well, I have nowhere else to be anyway… and I’ll probably be taking over Aiden’s job.
translation: 嗯，反正我也没别的地方可去……而且我可能会接替Aiden的工作。

source: I’ve grown quite fond of this place, after all.  And I’m even adjusting to a simpler life!
translation: 毕竟，我已经很喜欢这里了。而且我也正在适应更简单的生活！

source: So, call me Chef Emilia from now on~!
translation: 所以，以后叫我Emilia主厨吧～！

source: Just don’t forget all the recipes I taught you, alright?
translation: 只要别忘了我教给你的所有食谱，好吗？

source: NOOOOO! She’s a terrible cook, Aiden! She literally managed to burn an egg to a crisp!
translation: 不——！她的厨艺糟透了，Aiden！她居然能把鸡蛋烤成焦炭！

source: HEY! That was just an experiment!
translation: 喂！那只是一次实验！

source: We’re all going to miss Aiden’s cooking.
translation: 我们都会想念Aiden做的饭。

source: Ooh, ooh! We better get reserved VIP seats at your restaurant someday, alright Aiden?!
translation: 哦，哦！哪天我们一定要在你的餐厅预订 VIP 座位，对吧，Aiden？！

source: O-Of course!
translation: 当、当然！

source: You all don’t have to worry about us here at Camp Buddy too. You have helped us more than enough, especially you, Aiden.
translation: 你们也不用担心 Camp Buddy 的我们。你们已经帮了我们太多，尤其是你，Aiden。

source: Aww, Gramps…
translation: 哎呀，Gramps……

source: Oop! There’s our shuttle! I think that’s our cue to go.
translation: 哎呀！我们的接驳车来了！我想这就是我们该走的信号。

source: Goodbye, guys! It’s been a pleasure working with everyone!
translation: 再见，大家！能和大家一起工作是我的荣幸！

source: Camp Buddy will always be here for you all.
translation: Camp Buddy 永远会在这里等着你们。

source: Huhuhuhu…
translation: 呜呜呜……

source: Goodbye now.
translation: 再见了。

source: We’re just one message away…!
translation: 我们只要发一条消息就能联系上……！

source: I’ll miss all of you guys!
translation: 我会想念你们所有人的！

source: Oh no! I forgot to take one last group picture!
translation: 糟了！我忘了再拍一张最后的合照！

source: C-Come back!!!
translation: 快、快回来！！！

source: Y-Yuri?! You’re not gonna catch that bus on foot! Are you stupid?!
translation: 尤、Yuri？！你不可能靠双脚追上那辆接驳车！你傻了吗？！

source: I suppose I should go and report to Mr. Clermont that everyone departed safely.
translation: 我想我应该去向Clermont先生报告大家都已安全离开。

source: You’re going with him, right, Aiden?
translation: 你会和他一起去，对吧，Aiden？

source: Yeah… I guess that’s my cue to pack up too.
translation: 是啊……我想这就是我也该收拾行李的信号了。

source: Oh, I’ll help you out, Aiden!
translation: 哦，我来帮你吧，Aiden！

source: Thanks, Yoshi…
translation: 谢谢你，Yoshi……

source: Are you excited for the first day of your culinary career?
translation: 你对自己厨师生涯的第一天感到兴奋吗？

source: Well… I am… but I’m also sad that I’ll be leaving… you know, same old, same old.
translation: 嗯……是的……但我也很难过要离开……你懂的，老样子。

source: You’ll be fine, Aiden. We have our phones to stay in touch!
translation: 你会没事的，Aiden。我们有手机，可以保持联系！

source: Yeah… But with the curriculum I have, I’m gonna be really busy.
translation: 是啊……但按我的课程安排，我会非常忙。

source: I’m really worried about being away from you… especially since we just started dating…
translation: 我真的很担心和你分隔两地……尤其是我们才刚开始交往……

source: I promise we’ll be fine, Aiden! Long distance is hard, but we can make it work.
translation: 我保证我们会没事的，Aiden！异地很难，但我们能让它维持下去。

source: I guess you’re right… We’ll just have to find a way!
translation: 我想你说得对……我们只能想办法了！

source: I will miss you though, Aiden…
translation: 不过我会想你的，Aiden……

source: Me too.
translation: 我也是。

source: I guess that’s all of my stuff. I’m ready to leave now…
translation: 我想我的东西都收拾好了。我现在可以出发了……

source: You got your plane ticket ready, right? Your passport? IDs?
translation: 你的机票准备好了，对吧？护照呢？身份证件呢？

source: Yeah… You packed them for me yesterday.
translation: 是啊……你昨天已经替我收拾好了。

source: Okay, great!
translation: 好，太好了！

source: Well… Goodbye, Yoshi.
translation: 嗯……再见，Yoshi。

source: Good luck, Aiden… I’ll be cheering for you.
translation: 祝你好运，Aiden……我会为你加油的。

source: I love you!
translation: 我爱你！

source: *kisses Aiden’s cheek*
translation: *亲吻Aiden的脸颊*

source: Love you too.
translation: 我也爱你。

source: I’ll call everyone to send you off now, alright?
translation: 我现在就去叫大家来送你，好吗？

source: Okay…
{i}Aiden was really upset to leave Camp Buddy… And I have to admit, it was hard to watch him go…{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden很不想离开 Camp Buddy……我得承认，看着他离开也很难受……{/i}

source: {i}Even though I’d rather him be here with me, I’m sure that this was the right call so Aiden could follow his dreams.{/i}
translation: {i}虽然我更希望他留在我身边，但我相信这是正确的决定，Aiden可以去追逐自己的梦想。{/i}

source: {i}All of this will be worth it in the end… {/i}
translation: {i}这一切最终都会值得……{/i}

source: A few months later…
translation: 几个月后……

source: Oh Aiden! Why did you call? How have you been?
translation: 哦，Aiden！你怎么打电话来了？最近过得怎么样？

source: W-Well… busy as usual… The instructors here are really strict… and the exams are really hard…
translation: 这、这个嘛……和往常一样忙……这里的老师非常严格……考试也很难……

source: Some of my grades are actually starting to go down…
translation: 我的一些成绩其实已经开始下滑了……

source: Oh no, Aiden… It’s okay though! You can do it! I believe in you.
translation: 哦，不，Aiden……不过没关系！你能做到的！我相信你。

source: Yeah…
translation: 是啊……

source: How about you? The next term should’ve started by now right?
translation: 你呢？下个营期现在应该已经开始了吧？

source: Oh, yes! A lot of the scouts have come back, and well… they really miss you…
translation: 哦，是的！很多童军都回来了，而且……他们真的很想念你……

source: There’s also a lot of new scouts and scoutmasters as well. It’s been really busy around here…
translation: 这里还有很多新童军和童军团长。这里最近一直非常忙……

source: I think even Sir Goro and Yuri are getting overwhelmed, so I stepped in a little bit on the managerial side.
translation: 我想就连Goro先生和Yuri也快忙不过来了，所以我在管理方面稍微帮了点忙。

source: I see… It sounds fun there.
translation: 我明白了……听起来那里很有趣。

source: Yeah… Hell, but still fun…
translation: 是啊……累得要死，但还是很有趣……

source: Hey, uh… Yoshi… Are we gonna meet up soon? We haven’t seen each other in person for months now…
translation: 嘿，那个……Yoshi……我们很快能见面吗？我们已经好几个月没见过面了……

source: A-Ahh… Well… Like I mentioned, it’s been a little busy over here… I’m not sure if I can afford to take time off… You know how the summer is.
translation: 啊、啊……嗯……就像我说的，这边最近有点忙……我不确定自己能不能抽出时间……你也知道夏天有多忙。

source: And now with twice as many scouts, it’s really overwhelming.
translation: 现在童军数量翻了一倍，就更让人应接不暇了。

source: I’m sorry…
translation: 对不起……

source: It’s alright… I understand…
translation: 没关系……我理解……

source: Aiden… Are you okay…?
translation: Aiden……你还好吗……？

source: Yoshi…
translation: Yoshi……

source: I don’t think this will work for us…
translation: 我不认为我们这样下去能行……

source: Huh…? Wh-What are you saying, Aiden…?
translation: 啊……？你、你在说什么，Aiden……？

source: Well… I’m so overwhelmed with school… I haven’t made any friends here… and it’s so hard to be alone…
translation: 嗯……学校的事让我应接不暇……我在这里一个朋友也没交到……孤独一人真的很难熬……

source: I’m just so lonely again… it’s… reminding me of back then when you left for school…
translation: 我又变得如此孤独……这……让我想起了当年你离开去上学的时候……

source: I… really want you to be here, and to hear that you can’t come… it’s really disappointing…
translation: 我……真的很希望你能在这里，可听到你不能来……真的让我很失望……

source: I’m really sorry, Aiden… I promise I’ll make it up to you… maybe you just need time to—
translation: 我真的很抱歉，Aiden……我保证会补偿你……也许你只是需要一点时间来——

source: It’s been months since we last saw each other, Yoshi. You always say you’ll make it up to me, but nothing’s changed.
translation: 我们已经几个月没见面了，Yoshi。你总说会补偿我，但什么都没有改变。

source: How long do I have to wait… again?
translation: 我还要再等多久……？

source: I’m really sorry, Aiden, I wish I had more time. It’s really just the distance that’s been making things hard…
translation: 我真的很抱歉，Aiden，我真希望自己有更多时间。说到底，是距离让一切变得困难……

source: That’s the thing… you’re taking it for granted yet again… LDR doesn’t work for us obviously.
translation: 问题就在这里……你又一次把这一切当成理所当然……显然，异地恋不适合我们。

source: I know this is sounding unfair to you, but… I’ve been lonely like this for far too long…
translation: 我知道这听起来对你不公平，可是……我这样孤独太久了……

source: You know how much being apart hurts me… I lost my dad, I lost all my friends and now I can’t even see you…
translation: 你知道分开让我有多痛苦……我失去了爸爸，失去了所有朋友，现在甚至连你也见不到……

source: This is too much for me, Yoshi…
translation: 这对我来说太过分了，Yoshi……

source: Now here I am, alone in my room, wondering… if all of this is worth it…
translation: 而现在，我一个人待在房间里，想着……这一切到底值不值得……

source: I… want to make a choice for myself once and for all. I’m tired of going with the flow…
translation: 我……想彻底为自己做一次选择。我已经厌倦了随波逐流……

source: Ever since we’ve been in a relationship, I started having these expectations, and I can’t help but wonder if that was a mistake too…
translation: 自从我们交往以来，我开始抱有这些期待，也不禁怀疑那是否同样是个错误……

source: Wh-What…?
translation: 什、什么……？

source: I’ve thought about it for a long time, Yoshi… I think we should just be friends… at least for now…
translation: 我已经考虑很久了，Yoshi……我想我们还是做朋友吧……至少现在是这样……

source: A-Aiden…! I-I’m sorry, please let me make this right!  I’ll drop everything I’m doing right now! Let me fight for us!
translation: 艾、Aiden……！对、对不起，请让我弥补这一切！我现在就放下手头的一切！让我为我们的未来努力争取吧！

source: N-No, Yoshi, I’m not asking you… I’ve made up my mind already…
translation: 不、不是的，Yoshi，我不是在要求你……我已经下定决心了……

source: I think this was meant to happen all along. And it’s actually for the best, in a way we didn’t realize before.
translation: 我想这一切本来就注定会发生。某种程度上，这其实是最好的结果，只是我们之前没有意识到。

source: I’ve always anchored myself to you, and it’s about time I find my direction.
translation: 我一直把自己的人生寄托在你身上，现在是时候找到自己的方向了。

source: Pursuing this opportunity will help me find my own meaning in life.
translation: 追求这个机会会帮助我找到自己人生的意义。

source: I’m not turning away from you, especially not to the promise we made back then…
translation: 我不是要离开你，尤其不是要背弃我们当年的承诺……

source: I will come back to Camp Buddy… Once I become a professional chef…
translation: 我会回到 Camp Buddy……等我成为一名专业厨师之后……

source: So please, understand why I’m doing this, Yoshi…
translation: 所以，请理解我为什么要这样做，Yoshi……

source: I understand, Aiden…
translation: 我明白，Aiden……

source: Thank you, Yoshi.
translation: 谢谢你，Yoshi。

source: {i}After that call, Aiden set boundaries for us, and I couldn’t contact him any more…{/i}
translation: {i}那通电话之后，Aiden为我们划清了界限，我再也无法联系到他……{/i}

source: {i}In my heart, I realized how much I failed him by pushing him to make a choice I thought was for the best…{/i}
translation: {i}在我心里，我意识到自己逼他做出一个我以为对他最好的选择，实际上让他失望了多少……{/i}

source: {i}That’s why this time around, I had to respect his decision and let him go…{/i}
translation: {i}所以这一次，我必须尊重他的决定，放他离开……{/i}

source: {i}A year later, Aiden and I had remained out of touch with each other. {/i}
translation: {i}一年后，Aiden和我一直没有联系。{/i}

source: {i}Until I received the news that he had finally become a professional chef.{/i}
translation: {i}直到我收到消息，得知他终于成为了一名专业厨师。{/i}

source: {i}Each day, I would wait at the arches of Camp Buddy, holding on to his promise, waiting for him to come home to me again…{/i}
translation: {i}我每天都会在 Camp Buddy 的拱门旁等待，紧紧守着他的承诺，等他再次回到我身边……{/i}
